verdict.rationale: Bugbot's docs say that, once enabled, it automatically runs AI code review in the background on new PRs and on every PR update. Admins can scope it to all or selected repositories, set rules via BUGBOT.md, create org-wide rules in Bugbot Automations, and configure natural-language effort levels. Community reports confirm it runs live in orgs, and one user notes automatic reviews can be switched off in favor of on-request triggering. Missing for 10: automation is limited to PR-review triggers, with no evidence of user-defined custom automations, schedules or arbitrary workflows, and the Bugbot Automations scope is documented only as org-wide rules.
